description: This file implements the Zipf distribution as a Java class within the Apache Commons Math library. It provides methods for calculating probability, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and supports sampling via a random generator. It defines the class ZipfDistribution with associated properties and methods related to the distribution.

classes.name: ZipfDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Zipf distribution, providing probability calculations, distribution properties, and statistical measures such as mean and variance.

methods.name: getNumberOfElements
methods.description: Returns the number of elements (parameter N) of the Zipf distribution.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent parameter (s) of the Zipf distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function for a given integer x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability mass function for a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to a certain x.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the numerical mean of the distribution, calculating it if necessary.

methods.name: calculateNumericalMean
methods.description: Internal method to compute the mean based on generalized harmonic numbers.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the numerical variance of the distribution, calculating it if not already computed.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Internal method to compute the variance based on generalized harmonic numbers.

methods.name: generalizedHarmonic
methods.description: Calculates the nth generalized harmonic number for given n and m.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 1).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (equal to number of elements).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected (returns true).
